headline: Lenskart Solutions Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Lenskart Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of an additional stake in in Le Petit Lunetier Paris SAS, France, through its wholly owned subsidiary NESO Brands Pte. Ltd., Singapore
